Notes on Reliable Local Tooling

This short article is a fixture for the DualLens end to end tests. It mixes paragraphs, links, lists, tables and code so that every rule in the content pipeline gets exercised.

Quick start

Good translation tools keep the original structure of the page intact while adding a readable second line under each paragraph.

Read the getting started guide first, then the section on caching for the details.

The most important rule is that the original text must never be deleted, even while a translation is still pending.

Run npm run build in the project root before you open the page.

A block container with direct text and no paragraph wrapper should also be translated.
  • Install the extension from the unpacked folder.
  • Open any article and press the toggle shortcut.
  • Use the popup to switch between bilingual and translation-only views.
